--- title: "Towards regular production" subtitle: "A work plan for the energy and air emissions accounts" author: - name: Renato Vargas - name: Achille Pegoue date: "2026-12-10" date-format: long lang: en-US bibliography: ../../../assets/references.bib csl: ../../../assets/apa-en.csl execute: echo: false warning: false format: revealjs: theme: [simple, ../../../assets/slides.scss] footer: "Energy and emissions accounts for Tunisia" slide-number: true width: 1100 height: 700 title-slide-attributes: class: theme-title data-state: sans-pied --- ## What exists now {.theme-content} - A complete first compilation of both accounts, 2015 to 2022. - An open pipeline that reproduces the IMF tools and runs in under a minute. - Documents, Excel products in three languages and a data explorer. - A list of assumptions and open questions, each recorded in a lookup table. ## An annual cycle ```{mermaid} flowchart LR A["New balance (ONEM),
inventory (ANME),
SUT (INS)"] --> B["Add files to
data/sources/"] B --> C["Run the pipeline
and its checks"] C --> D["Review lookups
with data producers"] D --> C C --> E["Publish workbooks,
documents, explorer"] ``` ## Roles | Task | Who | |:--|:--| | Provide the energy balance, in a stable layout | ONEM | | Provide the CRT workbooks | ANME and inventory partners | | Provide the supply and use tables | INS, national accounts | | Run the pipeline, review lookups, publish | INS, environmental accounts | | Validate allocation choices | INS with ONEM and ANME | ## Priorities for the coming year 1. Validate the allocation assumptions with ONEM, ANME and the national accounts. 2. Obtain residence data for international transport. 3. Train a team at the INS to run and maintain the pipeline. 4. Agree on a first publication and its calendar. 5. Extend to air pollutants and to energy asset accounts when data allow. ## Skills and tools - Python with `uv`: one command to install, one to compile. - Lookup tables in CSV: edited in Excel, reviewed on GitHub. - Quarto for documents and the website. - The IMF tools remain the reference for checking. ## Points to discuss - Who leads the accounts at the INS, and with which team? - Formal agreements on data transmission with ONEM and ANME? - Hosting of the code and the website?
